note: An experiment (GAME_SPEC §7, §13.7, Stage 87; docs/CURRICULUM.md, experiment 40) on data/benches/peroxide.json: hydrogen peroxide decomposed by iodide, a catalyst, the oxygen collected in gas syringes and logged: the initial rate at two iodides gives the order in iodide; without iodide none comes.
title: Experiment: hydrogen peroxide and a catalyst

steps.title: Your guess
steps.text: Iodide speeds hydrogen peroxide's decomposition and is given back, a catalyst. Halve the iodide: how does the oxygen's rate change? Write the order in iodide you expect.

steps.title: The 0.5 M iodide into flask 1, its syringe on
steps.text: Pour all of t1 into f1 and put a syringe on its mouth at once: the oxygen pushes its plunger out at the room's pressure (it sticks a moment first, ground to its barrel).

steps.title: The 0.25 M iodide into flask 2, its syringe on
steps.text: t2 into f2, a syringe on it: half the iodide, the same volume.

steps.title: The water into flask 3, its syringe on
steps.text: t3 into f3, a syringe on it: no iodide at all, the peroxide alone.

steps.title: Log the three syringes
steps.text: Log each syringe's volume every 5 seconds.

steps.title: The oxygen comes off
steps.text: Wait for the first syringe to hold 40 mL. In the notebook, plot each against time: each starts straight once its plunger moves, its slope the initial rate, and bends as the peroxide is used up. The third does not move.

report.label: the initial rate with the 0.5 M iodide
report.why: In the notebook: s1's volume against time, fit over the minute from when its plunger first moves: the slope. The rate of oxygen is k1 [H2O2] [I-] for each kilogram of the solution: 0.0115 /M/s x 0.63 M x 0.146 M at 25 C, about 0.36 mL/s for its 14 g; at the room's 20 C less, and the reaction's heat warms it as it goes.

report.label: the initial rate with the 0.25 M iodide
the order in iodide
report.why: n = ln(rate 1 / rate 2) / ln 2. The slow step is H2O2 + I- -> H2O + IO-: half the iodide, half the rate. The iodide is given back by IO- + H2O2 -> H2O + O2 + I-: none of it is used.

report.label: the oxygen without iodide
report.why: Without a catalyst dilute peroxide keeps for months: no oxygen comes.
